_description: CCNL Edilizia Industria ANCE (CNEL F012), operaio comune at level 1, April 2026 regular run, permanent, full time, 173 ordinary hours worked: the tranche of 1 March 2026.
_notes: Row 'Operaio Comune liv. 1' of the ANCE Ragusa table of 1 March 2026: retribuzione base mensile 1.117,36, indennità di contingenza 512,87, E.D.R. 10,33; its hourly column is the monthly total over 173.

The operai are paid by the hour (Allegato A): 173 hours, the hourly divisor, pay the monthly amounts of the table, so base and allowances stay pinned to them. The base is the national minimo of level I from 1 March 2026 (ANCE table of the CCNL of 21 February 2025); contingenza and EDR are the bundle's fixed allowances (523.20).

hourly_percentages: the table prints no per-hour amount of them, only the rates in its notes ('pari al 4,95% della retribuzione', 'lorda del 18,50%'). Computed on minimo and contingenza, the elements of Art. 24 point 3 the bundle models (the EDR is not one of them): (1117.36 + 512.87) x 4.95% = 80.70 riposi annui, x 18.5% = 301.59 Cassa Edile, 382.29 in all. The 14.2% accrual withheld from the net, 231.49, is not pinned.

The ANCE Sassari table of 1 February 2025 prints per-hour amounts of both percentages (operaio comune 1,89 and 0,51), but for the 2025 tranche and on a sub-total that adds the provincial ITS 1,05 and the hourly EDR 0,06: not comparable, so not pinned.
The indennità territoriale di settore (166,67, provincial) is not modelled, nor the festività of April (Easter Monday): the period gross is not pinned.

source.document: ANCE Ragusa, Tabella delle retribuzioni impiegati e operai dal 1 marzo 2026
